For early check in, we recommend reserving for the prior night to guarantee immediate check in. The free luggage storage room is available at our hotel. Cancellation Policy : - Any cancellation​ or amendment is​ received before 1 days (​before ​24 hours) prior to​ your​ arrival date, no fee will be charged. - Any cancellation​ or amendment is​ received after 1 days (​ after 24 hours) to arrival date, 100% of the first night room fee and prepaid payment will be charged. - Failure to arrival at​ our​ hotel​ will be treated as No-show, 100% of ​the first night room fee and prepaid payment will be charged and hotel rooms are not guaranteed. - No-show 100% of the first night room fee and prepaid payment will be charged. Payment method : - By cash. - By Visa Card, Master Card and American Express plus 3% bank fee is applied. Children and Extra beds : Child under 6 years old: Free of charge and share bed with parents. Child from 6 years and over: surcharge US$ 12/person/night for additional child or an extra bed Adults: surcharge US$12/person/night for additional person or an extra bed. Pets : Not allowed.
